business.what: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC) provides catering, online ticketing, packaged drinking water (Rail Neer), and tourism services associated with the Indian Railways, making money through service charges, convenience fees, and product sales.
business.geography: Operates predominantly in India, with foreign exchange earnings of ₹59.22 Crore and foreign exchange outgo of ₹6.09 Crore for FY 2025-26.

claims.claim: Profit after tax stood at INR330 crores, supported by healthy performance across our Catering, Tourism, and Internet Ticketing segments.
claims.quote: During the quarter, profit after tax stood at INR330 crores, supported by healthy performance across our Catering, Tourism, and Internet Ticketing segments.

claims.claim: Nearly 89% of the reserved railway tickets in India are now booked through our online platform.
claims.quote: nearly 89% of the reserved railway tickets in India are now booked through our online platform, underscoring our leadership in digital tech stack.

claims.claim: Rail Neer margins were impacted by a 30% increase in the resin component due to petroleum price rises.
claims.quote: Due to the increase of petroleum product due to West Asia crisis, the material cost increased from INR55 crores to INR61 crores.

claims.claim: We have submitted the final application for payment aggregator license to RBI on 4th August 2026.
claims.quote: They had given us a time limit for submitting the final application on 4th August 2026. We have submitted the final application number one.

claims.claim: IRCTC commands 89% share of reserved railway tickets.
claims.quote: You will be glad to know that today we command 89% share of reserved railway tickets

claims.claim: Internet ticketing segment delivered robust profitability with an EBITDA margin of 76%.
claims.quote: this segment continued to deliver robust profitability with EBITDA margin of 76% driven by strong operating leverage and sustained cost efficiencies.

claims.claim: Catering margins were impacted by higher sales contribution from train catering and pilot branded catering projects.
claims.quote: The margins in this segment were impacted due to higher sales contribution from train catering operations and pilot initiatives such as branded catering projects

claims.claim: Company recorded its highest ever revenue from operations at Rs. 5,215 crores in FY 2025-26.
claims.quote: IRCTC recorded its highest ever revenue from operations at Rs. 5,215 crores in the Financial Year 2025-26 compared to Rs. 4,675 crores in FY 2024-25

claims.claim: EBITDA margins moderated slightly due to changes in revenue mix, particularly higher contribution from catering and provisions.
claims.quote: margins moderated slightly due to changes in revenue mix, particularly higher contribution from catering and provisions, our overall profitability remained strong and sustainable.

claims.claim: Nearly 89% of reserved railway tickets in India are now booked through the online platform.
claims.quote: Nearly 89% of the reserved railway tickets in India are now booked through our online platform, underscoring our leadership in digital ticketing.

claims.claim: Tourism delivered an excellent performance with revenue of INR 289 crores, marking a 29% year-on-year growth despite temporary geopolitical disruptions.
claims.quote: Tourism delivered an excellent performance with revenue of INR 289 crores, marking a 29% year-on-year growth despite temporary geopolitical disruptions.

claims.claim: The Board has sanctioned installation of 4 new plants at Mysore, Prayagraj, Bhagalpur and Ranchi, adding 25% to 30% capacity in 1.5 years.
claims.quote: our Board has already sanctioned for installation of 4 new plants at Mysore , Prayagraj, Bhagalpur and Ranchi. So we'll be adding around 25% to 30% capacity in say -- in 1.5 years.

claims.claim: Profit after tax stood at Rs. 342 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 11%.
claims.quote: The Company reported a profit after tax of Rs. 342 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 11.%

claims.claim: EBITDA for the quarter stood at Rs. 404 crores, an increase of 8.31% year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 35.25%.
claims.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at Rs. 404 crores, an increase of 8.31% year -on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 35.25%

claims.claim: Revenue from operations for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs. 1,146 crores, up by 7.71% from Rs. 1,064 crores.
claims.quote: Revenue from operations for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs. 1,146 crores, up by 7.71% from Rs. 1,064 crores

claims.claim: Currently 89.24% of total reserved tickets of Indian railways are booked through our online platform.
claims.quote: Currently 89.24% of total reserved tickets of Indian railways are booked through our online platform.

claims.claim: Mostly more than 80% of debtors is with railways, which is our parent organization.
claims.quote: mostly this is more than 80% with railways, which is our parent organization.

claims.claim: PAT for Q1 FY26 stood at INR330 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 7.14%.
claims.quote: I am pleased to report that Q1 FY '26 has been a stable and profitable quarter for the company with a PAT of INR330 crores, reflecting a year -on-year growth of 7.14%.

claims.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY26 stood at INR397 crores, up 5.86% year-on-year, driven by improved operational efficiency.
claims.quote: Our EBITDA for this quarter stood at INR 397 crores, up 5.86% year -on-year. It is driven by improved operational efficiency.

claims.claim: EBITDA margin expanded to 34.27% compared to 33.55% in Q1 FY25.
claims.quote: Further, our EBITDA margin also expanded to 34.27% compared to 33.55% in Q1 FY '25, reflecting continued emphasis on cost optimization and better revenue mix management.

claims.claim: Revenue from operations grew by around 4% year-on-year, reaching INR1,160 crores.
claims.quote: Revenue from operations grew by around 4% year -on-year, reaching INR1,160 crores. That is driven by continued growth in Tourism and Internet Ticketing segment.

claims.claim: Internet Ticketing revenue stood at INR360 crores, marking a 9.12% growth on year-on-year basis, with 87.78% of total reserved tickets booked through the portal.
claims.quote: Revenue from this segment has stood at INR360 crores, marking a 9.12% growth on year-on-year basis. 87.78% of total reserved tickets on Indian Railways are now booked through our portal.

claims.claim: Tourism segment posted revenue of INR148 crores, 21.3% up on year-on-year basis.
claims.quote: This segment has posted impressive revenue of INR 148 crores. It is 21.3% up on year -on- year basis.

claims.claim: Q4 FY25 has been an exceptional quarter with our company achieving an all-time high operating revenue of INR1,269 crores.
claims.quote: I am pleased to report that Q4 FY '25 has been again an exceptional quarter with our company achieving an all-time high operating revenue of INR1,269 crores.

claims.claim: The net worth of the company increased to INR3,663 crores in financial year 2024-25, up from INR3,230 crores.
claims.quote: The net worth of the company has increased to INR3,663 crores in financial year '24-'25, which is up from INR3,230 crores in financial year 2023-24

claims.claim: We have submitted in principle approval with RBI for payment aggregator license in December 24 and are awaiting response.
claims.quote: As about the RBI license, we have submitted in principle approval with RBI in December '24. They have asked for certain clarification

claims.claim: Daily average ticket booking this quarter is INR14.33 lakhs per day as against INR12.91 lakhs per day last year.
claims.quote: Daily average ticket booking this quarter is INR14.33 lakhs per day as against INR12.91 lakhs per day last -- around 11%.

claims.claim: E-catering business annually grew from INR33 crores last year to INR54 crores this year, a growth of 63%.
claims.quote: annually we grew from INR33 crores last year to INR54 crores this year. That is a growth of 63%.
